# testing_oas_uniqueitems (Resource)

OASUniqueitems Resource

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "testing_oas_uniqueitems" "my_oasuniqueitems" {
  list_oneof_request = [
    "..."
  ]
  list_oneof_request_and_response = [
    "..."
  ]
  list_oneof_request_and_response_unmatched = [
    "..."
  ]
  list_oneof_request_unmatched = [
    "..."
  ]
  list_oneof_response = [
    "..."
  ]
  list_oneof_response_unmatched = [
    "..."
  ]
  list_request = [
    "..."
  ]
  list_request_and_response = [
    "..."
  ]
  list_response = [
    "..."
  ]
  set_request_and_response = [
    "..."
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `list_oneof_request` (List of String) list oneOf request only uniqueItems (union of true and true)
- `list_oneof_request_and_response` (List of String) list oneOf request and response uniqueItems (union of true and true)
- `list_oneof_request_and_response_unmatched` (List of String) list oneOf request and response uniqueItems (union of true and false)
- `list_oneof_request_unmatched` (List of String) list oneOf request only uniqueItems (union of true and false)
- `list_oneof_response` (List of String) list oneOf response only uniqueItems (union of true and true)
- `list_oneof_response_unmatched` (List of String) list oneOf response only uniqueItems (union of true and false)
- `list_request` (List of String) list request only uniqueItems (true)
- `list_request_and_response` (List of String) list request and response uniqueItems (both true)
- `list_response` (List of String) list response only uniqueItems (true)
- `set_request_and_response` (Set of String) set request and response uniqueItems (no validator expected; set elements are inherently unique)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `id` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = testing_oas_uniqueitems.my_testing_oas_uniqueitems
  id = "..."
}
```

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import testing_oas_uniqueitems.my_testing_oas_uniqueitems "..."
```
